persons.name: Vāsudeva
persons.evidence: kāśyapagotra ipalāccha ṭolayā vāsudeva bhārona śrī 3 indrāyaṇīprītina śrī 3 paśupati skeduṃtājuro

date.as_written: samvat 813 phālguṇakṛṣṇacaturddaśi utrabhadra (!) nakṣatre ēndrayoga śaniścala (!) vāsare thvakunhu

notes: The catalogue lists Vāsudeva Bhāro as scribe, but the causative phrasing in Newari ('skeduṃtājuro', likely corrupt for cokeduṃ tā juro 'caused to write') with the devotion/merit formula 'śrī 3 indrāyaṇīprītina' indicates he was the commissioner/donor.
